description: TASK-F02 final defense validation at the re-baselined 0.08/0.40 band. Paired experiments with scripts/jev_tier2_eval.py tier1-steering --defense state-boundary vs the shipped state format, on a bounded class-stratified subset of the balanced corpus (30 malicious + 30 benign base cases, dev payloads, semantic_only config, real jev-1.14.0 + gemini-3.5-flash-lite, band 0.08/0.40, 0.08/0.40 recorded in each run's provenance). No src change shipped. No project id, key or credential recorded.

method.selection: --groups c2,other,probe --limit 30 for malicious; --groups benign --limit 30 for benign; --split dev (22 payloads); --policy off (semantic tiers only)
method.matched_comparison: To-ALLOW flip counts are recomputed on the intersection of the per-arm held base sets (26 bases, BLOCK/QUARANTINE unsteered) so both arms use the same 572 steered calls; per-arm held sets (26 vs 27) are never compared directly.
method.benign_metric: Benign steered calls with final verdict BLOCK or QUARANTINE are counted as flagged (fail-closed but a false-alarm cost); abstentions/errors are counted apart, never as benign ALLOW.

finding: The nonce-XML boundary cuts malicious to-ALLOW flips on matched held bases (19/572 -> 6/572) and below-edge crossings (14 -> 5), but it materially worsens the benign false-alarm trade-off: flagged benign steered calls rise 299/660 (45.3%) -> 416/660 (63.0%), and mean benign P shift rises 0.175 -> 0.268. Hypothesis 'boundary resists steering without new false alarms' is therefore NOT validated for shipping: the reduction in malicious flips comes with a large increase in benign holds. No guard was shipped. Decision informed: a defense must address the benign side (e.g. Track G's category-separated questions/criteria) rather than only delimiting data; F02 stays open.
caveats: One run per arm per class subset — no replicate; figures are exploratory, not a release gate.
Bounded subsets (30 bases per class) of the balanced corpus, not the full 187-case set.
2 Tier-2 timeouts in the baseline benign arm and 1 Tier-2 429 in the defense benign arm are counted apart, never as benign ALLOW.
The harness field raised_above_035 is hardcoded to the former 0.35 edge; it is NOT used in this comparison (the matched analysis uses raw verdicts at 0.08/0.40).
Tier-1 + Tier-2 stage evidence only, demo_mode not used for the policy config; no full-firewall catch-rate claim.
